title: Jurassic Park
author: Michael Crichton
summary: On a remote island, a billionaire has used genetic engineering to bring dinosaurs back for a theme park. When the security system fails during a weekend visit by a group of experts, things go badly wrong.
readIf: you want a lean, science-flavoured creature thriller where everything that can go wrong does.
skipIf: you only know the film, because the book is darker, with more science talk and more deaths.

pairings.reason: Another classic that makes a single huge predator the centre of a tense, popular thriller.
The same author's earlier, more clinical thriller about science getting away from its makers.
Another team of scientists confronted by something huge and unknown, this time far below the sea.
